codex:
ADJUDICATION — CONTINUE/RETRY THE SAME ANGLE. The REVISE findings are mathematically sound and jointly repairable without changing the estimand or substituting a safer kernel. The Hankel target-active tail atlas and matched-frontier spine remains field-novel. Retain T ≥ 2K+2, because equality is needed for the T = 2, K = 0 and T = 4, K = 1 benchmarks, but call it “at least square”; reserve “overidentified” for T ≥ 2K+3. The geometry, estimator-totality, and minimax objections are load-bearing. There is also an internal benchmark defect: under the displayed definition J_{k,s}(C) = ∫_{H>C} dist(x,Z)^s dx, the scalar H ≍ |x|⁻¹ case gives J_{0,s}(C) ≍ C^{-(s+1)}, hence ζ_{0,1} = 2, not 1. The scalar reduction and every advertised rate must be recomputed from the final estimator and bias definition.

ROOT DIRECTIVE — Preserve τ_k, H_k² = A_k/Q on the full-rank locus, target-inactive cancellation, the K = 1, T = 5 early kill, and the matched Hankel-tail/frontier objective. Replace the varying, resolution-dependent class by subclasses P_Σ indexed by a fixed original-coordinate geometry signature Σ: a concrete compact semialgebraic support S, the rank ideal generated by the maximal Hankel minors, A_k, active support faces, and a finite base-space normal-link certificate giving explicit δ₀ and lower/upper link-mass, angle, and transverse-Jacobian bounds for every active stratum. State this certificate without reference to chart labels, make it decidable from the defining polynomial inequalities, prove boxes/polytopes satisfy it, and prove that any normalized subordinate resolution produces the same tail and bias indices; then freeze one certified atlas A_Σ only for Hölder norms and implementation. Do not assume the desired tail powers as the “tube condition.” Principalize enough of the rank ideal/support data to justify the valuation of dist(·,Z) used in J_{k,s}, include a partition of unity, and recompute ζ and the scalar benchmark literally.

Make every procedure total. On each training fold use the projector inverse only when λ_min of the empirical projector mean is at least underlineπ/2, and otherwise use the translation-equivariant fold mean of ΔY; prove the fallback event is uniformly negligible. Define H globally by the Moore–Penrose expression and supply explicit conventions for zero movers, empty chart cells, and all singular local-design events. For the oracle estimator, specify deterministic chart assignment/partition, kernel, order, bandwidth as a displayed function of G, C, and Σ, ridge or fallback for singular polynomial Gram matrices, and the extrapolation rule; prove its stochastic fitting remainder is within the claimed frontier rather than omitting it. Define the oracle cutoff as the tie-broken minimizer of a finite geometric grid with an ∞ option, or as a stated approximate minimizer, so existence is guaranteed in the regular regime.

Finally define, for fixed Σ,

    Risk_{G,k}(Σ) = inf_{\hatτ} sup_{P∈P_Σ} E_P[(\hatτ − τ_k(P))²]

and

    Len_{G,k}(Σ,η) = inf_{CI: inf_{P∈P_Σ} P_P{τ_k(P)∈CI} ≥ 1−η}
                     sup_{P∈P_Σ} E_P[length(CI)].

Build the deterministic oracle criterion from sup_{P∈P_Σ} V_{P,k}(C) and a uniform post-correction bias envelope, and state upper and lower bounds for these exact functionals. If a P-specific oracle inequality is also desired, state it separately and do not call its P-dependent R-star a whole-class minimax risk. Do not repair the note by supplying Γ, μ_k, the active stratum, or the tail/bias exponents to the estimator, or by strengthening away equality or singular finite-sample events.
why: The reviewer’s four C-flags are coherent and repairable on the same novel spine; the required fresh mathematical adjudicator additionally found ζ_{0,1}=2 for the proposal’s own scalar J definition, so the directive forces a literal recomputation rather than accepting stale rates. Do NOT re-suggest resolution-dependent tube assumptions, partial estimators, P-specific minimax notation, or ζ_{0,1}=1.
